تعتزلون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِلُونَ (taʕtazilūna) /taʕ.ta.zi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# تُعْتَزَلُونَ (tuʕtazalūna) /tuʕ.ta.za.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
